scenario: Constructed: certainty, left-out appearance and grade (minor), structured category, a hedge between two routine findings
description: Constructed. 'Small bowel dilatation up to 3.8 cm compatible with…' vs 'Mild small bowel dilatation up to 3.8 cm with air-fluid…': appearance minor (pred leaves out the air-fluid levels but already calls an obstruction, so nothing urgent is hidden), grade minor (pred leaves out the mild grade of the dilatation; a low grade left out changes nothing), diagnosis major (pred adds a small bowel obstruction the gt does not state; obstruction calls for surgical review); 'Possible minimally displaced right inferior pubic ramus…' vs 'Minimally displaced right inferior pubic ramus fracture': certainty major (possible vs definite pubic ramus fracture, two steps; a possible fracture is sent for more imaging); 'Bosniak IIF left renal cyst' vs 'Bosniak II left renal cyst': grade major (Bosniak IIF vs II cyst; IIF needs imaging follow-up, II does not); 'No definite gallstones' vs 'No gallstones': certainty minor (no definite vs no gallstones, one step; two routine completeness statements, the hedge changes no management).
